The '''Battle of Chabosh''' was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. After a [[Rebel Alliance cell (Chabosh)|Rebel cell]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chabosh]] overthrew the local [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harsh]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Cauldron (Imperial-class)|''Cauldron'']] personally led a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Company/Legends|company]] in crushing the uprising, but he was severely wounded during the battle. Harsh's victory and subsequent recovery without the aid of surgical [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] made him a legend and enabled his swift rise through the Imperial [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]].

==Prelude==
[[Chabosh]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Gamer" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Chabosh system/Legends|Chabosh system]]</ref> became the site of a [[Rebel Alliance cell (Chabosh)|Rebel Alliance cell]]<ref name="CSWE-Chabosh" /> about [[2 BBY/Legends|two years before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] succeeded in overthrowing the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in an uprising and established themselves in a [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]] protected by powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="Gamer" /> In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dispatched<ref name="CSWE-Harsh">{{CSWECite|II|22|Harsh, Moff}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harsh]],<ref name="Gamer" /> [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Cauldron (Imperial-class)|''Cauldron'']], to eliminate the Rebel threat on Chabosh.<ref name="CSWE-Harsh" />

==The battle==
The ''Cauldron'' joined an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in forming a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet. In the battle's final assault, Harsh personally led a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]<ref name="Gamer" /> against the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Rebel Alliance forces]]. Although he suffered terrible injuries to his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] in the fighting,<ref name="CSWE-Harsh" /> Harsh wiped out the Rebel cell.<ref name="CSWE-Chabosh" />

==Aftermath==
According to a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|medical droid's]] diagnosis back aboard the ''Cauldron'', Harsh's severe injuries required [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacements, but he aggressively refused.<ref name="Gamer" /> Instead, Harsh willed his legs to heal without surgical assistance,<ref name="CSWE-Harsh" /> and his legend was born. Promotions came his way at a storied pace over dozens of more senior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. Less than a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Battle of Chabosh, in a private ceremony, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="Gamer" /> personally named Harsh [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Bosph sector/Legends|Bosph sector]].<ref name="CSWE-Harsh" />

''[[The Republic Journal of Law-Enforcement and Low-Intensity Conflict]]'', an underground scholarly forum dedicated to analyzing non-warfare conflict, later detailed Harsh's role in the Battle of Chabosh and his resultant rise to power in its "[[Threat Dossier]]" newsletter.<ref name="Gamer" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Chabosh was created as part of the character backstory for Imperial Moff Harsh in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' article "[[Unusual Suspects]]," written by [[Andrew Hind]] for the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine, which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Gamer" /> on [[September 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref>
